[i][b]Exporting Cheese to the Bobian Principality[/b]

On April 20, 2025, representatives of the Democratic Federation of Indonocaismnic and the Principality of Bobia gathered in the Jakitl Mecu Trade Deal to form a new collaboration in cheese trade. The two nations struck an agreement whereby the Federation would provide the Principality with its finest and cheapest cheeses.

In the agreement, the Federation will sell 3,000 metric tons of quality cheese every year. It will be split into twelve equal monthly shipments to ensure a consistent supply. The products from Ziranak Alpine Cheese Company and Ulkis Uman Cheese, famous for their strong, spicy, and Nutty flavors, with a special native spice and a Classic Aged Cheddar, aged for 18 months to create a pungent and good quality. At prices of $4,800 per metric ton, the trading is worth $14.4 million-$10.5 million in USD per year. Payment will be made every quarter by wire transfer.

Both nations desire to be sustainable and have introduced new concepts into their logistics plans. Deliveries will employ green refrigerated ships that incorporate solar-powered cold storage. The cheese will be exported from the Jakitl Mecu International Trade Port and transported to Port Bobiana.

In order to promote trade, the Principality has decided not to charge any fee on imports of cheese for the first two years of the agreement. In return, the Federation will phase out taxes on Bobian luxury exports like fine wines and handmade chocolates by 15% over three years.

The agreement will last for five years, from 2025 to 2030. The two countries will examine the deal after this term to see if they want to extend it. In case one of the parties needs to exit the deal because they were not able to meet their commitments or due to a change in policies, they must give six months' written notice.

In the event of divergence, the parties commit themselves to settle disagreements through discussions among themselves, or, where required, with the assistance of the International Trade Council. This Cheese Export Trade Agreement was signed on April 20, 2025. Attended by members of the International Trade Council and witnessed by observers from the Multicultural Trade Commission, this agreement marks the beginning of a trade relationship between the two nations.
[/i]

[b][i]Nasty Tactics | 0.2[/i][/b]

Freedom. Liberation. Praise. This is what happened in the last post, and what will happen now.

Operation salt was being prepared. A series of bombings across the enemy territory around the frontlines. It will take a while, but it will get done. In the meanwhile, another operation was being prepared for. They had to make a wound to sprinkle the salt in. Operation egg was the next step towards winning. It was a major offensive. After two weeks, and rumors of spies infiltrating Gendarme's military, it was finally done. Around the east coast, there would be a connection from Arenenge's army to the GCPR's army.  They know Gendarme was prepared, but not for this. First, they would catapult north for a good bit, the Arenenge's army would split into two divisions. The east division would capture a small portion of Gendarme's area via encirclement, and the west division would complete operation egg. In the north, it was far more flat, meaning the GCPR would have higher ground to their advantage. Long range tanks, such as the Challenger three, with rocket artillery such as the M142 HIMARS, and counter artillery such as the M270 MLRS. after that barrage, a wave of infantry and battle tanks will advance swiftly but strategically. the main tanks used are going to be the T-90M for its speed, and the M1A2 Abrams for its armor and firepower. Behind them lay another barrage of artillery, this time not so much, though.

Explosions. Commands. Treading. [i]Operation egg was a go. The sound of artillery almost deafened the enemy, and the sounds of yelling could not be heard. Almost an hour of artillery later, tanks finally roll in through rows, hoping to flank the enemy from the sides. The infantry went head on, wiping out the anti-tank personnel before they could recognize that those tanks weren't friendly. The open field with spots of trees is what made this that much more successful. Even though Gendarme put up more of a fight then we anticipated, step one was a success. 1,850 enemy soldiers were captured, and sent to prison for interrogation and other information things.[/i]

The enemy soldiers were encircled at last. It was a small encirclement, but it as very good progress. With no supply, they were at risk. Attrition was the name of the game. after 3 days, they finally cleared out the land, and was ready for their next mission. Operation salt was finished a couple days after the encirclement was taken. They had been manufacturing special Rockwell B-1B Lancers, and B-2 Bomber planes for the operation. They were modified to be cheaper, so they had less armor. The good side is that there are a lot more bombers, and they can all be backed up by a large squad of fighter jets. The bombers would bomb essential Gendarmite buildings, like military bases, supply buildings, gunsmiths, enemy fortifications, and terrain that may harm the friendly armies. They would also act as a reconnaissance team, to survey the land for suspicious buildings or activities. The line of which they will bomb will be fairly small, because infantry, anti-infantry, and anti-tanks vehicles will need to quickly plow through them. There were special teams that were made with a no-return. This team volunteered to go deep into enemy teritory, where it is most likely they will die. Their objective is to gather as much information on what was going on inside. It would be transferred through a live, wireless camera with a microphone. They obviously knew it could be intercepted, so they programmed it, so if it detects more than one line using it, it would self explode. (the explosion is only enough to bust the internals, not enough to do any harm) The planes used for this were very cheap, but fast, capable of going up to Mach 6. 

[b]OPERATION SALT STARTS IN TWO DAYS,[/b][nation]Gendarme[/nation], [b]PREPARE THYSELF.[/b]

(this was just something to get the roleplays stirring again.)
